sources.snippet: Residential- Reroof Online Permitting When applying for a residential re-roof permit online, please note that these permits are auto-issue permits, which means that once you have submitted your application packet, the fees will automatically generate, and you will be issued the building permit. However, if the property is in a flood zone, additional reviews will be required before the permit can be issued.
